title: Jia Yuezhi's FF Unveils Nine EAI Robots in One Go, the Most Expensive Exceeds 920,000 Yuan
excerpt: Faraday Future (FF) held the 919 FF EAI Robot "Four-Core Full Intelligence" series new product launch event on September 19th in US local time. The event launch
content_html:
Faraday Future (FF) held the 919 FF EAI Robot "Four-Core Full Intelligence" series new product launch event on September 19th in US local time. The event launched five major models and nine configurations of EAI robot bodies, including FF All-New Futurist, FF Master Mini, FX Aegis Hyper, FX Aegis Mega, and FX Aegis Classic Ultra-W, as well as four industry productivity solutions for K-12 education, research, security, and inspection.

According to the official introduction, the FF "Four-Core Full Intelligence" open ecosystem consists of the EAI brain and developer platform, EAI body, industry productivity solutions, and EAI data factory. Jia Yueting stated that FF aims to build not a single form of all-around robot, but a robot ecosystem supported by a general and versatile EAI brain, with various body forms, and continuously evolving through Agents, Skills, and real-world scenario data.

From 67,000 to 926,000 yuan, covering humanoid and quadruped

The nine new products cover two forms: humanoid and quadruped. The flagship full-size humanoid robot FF All-New Futurist has 51 active degrees of freedom, and after upgrading the high-end dexterous hand, it can reach up to 71. The dual battery with 1152 watt-hours supports about 8 hours of operation; the Ultra version is equipped with NVIDIA Jetson Thor, with a computing power of 700 TOPS. The standard version is priced at $89,900 (approximately 604,000 RMB), while the Ultra version is priced at $129,900 (approximately 873,000 RMB).

The FF Master Mini series is positioned for education and sports competitions, with a height of approximately 95 centimeters and a weight of about 19.5 kilograms. Three configurations offer 48, 117, and 200 TOPS of computing power respectively, with the starting price at $9,990 (approximately 67,000 RMB). In terms of quadrupeds, the large industrial-level FX Aegis Hyper starts at $137,900 (approximately 926,000 RMB), making it the most expensive of this release; the medium-sized FX Aegis Mega can carry up to 50 kilograms, priced at $74,990 (approximately 504,000 RMB); and the lightweight security and companionship FX Aegis Classic Ultra-W is priced at $12,990 (approximately 87,000 RMB).

With the release of these new products, the FF EAI robot product system now covers three forms: humanoid, quadruped, and wheel-arm. It includes five series: Futurist, Master, Aegis, Navi, and Faber, with a total of 11 models and 24 products.

Launched and Sold Immediately, with a "6+1" Direct Sales and Leasing System

In the four industry solutions, K-12 education and research form the Education Ecosystem Solution 1.0, offering three levels of courses including Blockly, Python, and ROS, along with unified SDK, simulation, and digital twin capabilities. The security and inspection solutions are aimed at communities, parks, energy, power, mines, and tunnels, supporting multi-machine management, autonomous patrols, thermal imaging, and gas detection.

FF provides three types of combinations: standard body, "body + skill package," and "body + solution." It has established a "6+1" direct sales and shared leasing system, with six channels including B2B, FF Par, and e-commerce uniformly accessing orders, delivery, pricing, and after-sales systems. Subsidiary AIxC's RoboShare offers on-demand leasing. All new products have started sales and delivery, and users can place orders through the official website and channels such as Amazon and RobotShop.
